speaker: Ms Poh Li San
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) whether HDB will exercise flexibility towards home buyers affected by earlier than expected BTO completion; and (b) whether HDB will consider (i) flexibility for the second downpayment timeline (ii) transitional support for young working adults or (iii) any other practical arrangements for buyers who face genuine difficulty because their flats are completed significantly earlier than projected.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: These include any updates to their flat’s probable completion date and the latest probable completion date is also available to buyers when they log into their accounts on the MyHDB Page.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Those who face difficulties due to early completions can approach HDB for assistance.

speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang West)
text: I have a supplementary question on such an arrangement for existing flat owners who require back-to-back sale of their existing homes to finance their BTO flats.

speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang West)
text: So, if there is an earlier-than-expected BTO readiness, they do not have sufficient time to sell the flat, especially in a down cycle market.

speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang West)
text: Will HDB further extend beyond the usual six months period, to allow them a bit more time to do so?

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Earlier, I mentioned in my reply that the HDB notifies buyers at three junctures.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: This is to give buyers adequate time to plan.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: And that is why it is at the one year before, six months before and three months before.
